newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Aida says in disposal talks with management.
newsitem.headline: Aida says in disposal talks with management.

text.p: Aida Holdings Ltd said on Friday that the Aida Family Trust and Mrs Aida Geffen had started negotations regarding the disposal of a controlling interest in the firm to a consortium which includes senior members of the group's management.

The talks contemplate that minority shareholders will be invited to participate in the disposal, and if successfully concluded, an offer on the same or comparable terms will be made to those shareholders.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
The notice follows an announcement on June 11 that a consortium led by Lew Geffen of Lew Geffen Estates will not buy a controlling stake in or take management control of Aida.
Geffen, who had been appointed managing director of Aida, said he would step down from this position.
